description: Platform-agnostic workflow definitions for AI-Native Development lifecycle

parallel-execution.description: Reference patterns for Phase 1.5 Parallel Execution — Claude Code-only subagent fan-out used by review/fix/deliver workflows and some prompt templates. Not a slash command.

core.description: Primary workflow personas — referenced by workflows below

supporting.description: Domain knowledge and reference — used by core skills internally

tool-specific.description: External tool integrations — install only if using that tool

frontend-tools.description: Frontend/UX specialized skills — design, audit, and demo tools

ideate.description: Diverge → converge an initial idea/pain-point into a BA-Ready Brief at docs/foundation-input-sources/ideation-brief.md (Phase 0, optional)

argument.hint: <problem-statement e.g. "checkout ใช้เวลา 5 นาที" | 'resume' | empty for interactive>

ba.description: Run BA requirements discovery → produce 5 BA deliverables in docs/ba/01-05 (Phase 1A; v1.2: 06-handoff dropped — wraps ba-requirements-prompt.md so the agent gets full onboarding context every time)

argument.hint: <optional focus hint e.g. "MVP only" | "include mobile" | empty for default>

ba-review.description: Audit BA deliverables and generate a structured Claim Review file

ba-rebuttal.description: Analyze, implement fixes, and write rebuttal for a BA Claim Review round

sd.description: Run System Design → produce 6 design docs in docs/design-docs/02-08 (v1.2: gaps 01/06 merged into 02) + ADRs + API specs (Phase 1B — wraps system-design-master-prompt.md so the agent gets full onboarding context every time)

argument.hint: <optional focus hint e.g. "focus on payment flow" | "skip Evolution Sequence — greenfield monolith" | empty for default>

sd-review.description: Audit system design documents (architecture-only, no implementation phasing) and generate a structured Claim Review file

sd-rebuttal.description: Analyze, implement fixes, and write rebuttal for a System Design Claim Review round

td.description: Run Technical Design → produce 3 TD docs in docs/technical-design/02,03,04 (Phase 1D — wraps technical-design-master-prompt.md so the agent gets full onboarding context every time, and enforces SD-as-Master scope contract)

argument.hint: <optional focus hint e.g. "focus on payment-service backend" | "frontend only — no DB changes" | empty for default>

td-review.description: Audit technical design documents and generate a structured Claim Review file

td-rebuttal.description: Analyze, implement fixes, and write rebuttal for a Technical Design Claim Review round

project-init.description: Generate project-specific CLAUDE.md + .claude/rules/ from approved Technical Design (Phase 2.5 bridge between Design QA and Implement)

impl-plan.description: Consume SD hints (Evolution Sequence + Phase Hints) + work inventory and generate a phase-grouped plan (P1→P2→P3→P4) with honor/override audit trail

impl-plan-review.description: Audit the implementation plan (10 dimensions including SD hint alignment, AC dual-track, deferred-AC registry, state reconciliation, readability) and generate a structured Claim Review file. Mirrors BA/SD/UX/TD review pattern.

impl-plan-rebuttal.description: Analyze plan review findings, fix impl-plan.md (and registry/overview as scoped), and write rebuttal report

impl-task.description: Pick a task from the implementation plan, auto-detect size, implement, test, commit, and update handoff. Supports parallel mode for Claude Code subagent fan-out.

impl-review.description: Review implementation code for quality, security, and design compliance

impl-review-fix.description: Analyze code review findings, implement fixes, and write fix report

qa-review.description: Audit QA Plan deliverables and generate a structured Claim Review file

qa-rebuttal.description: Analyze QA review findings, fix QA deliverables, and write rebuttal report

qa-execute.description: Run tests from the approved QA Plan, map results to traceability matrix, and produce an Execution Report (Phase 3T — bridge to Harden)

qa-execute-fix.description: Classify failing tests from a QA Execution Report (code/test/spec/plan/flake/env) and route fixes to the correct agent/command

red-team.description: Run security audit (OWASP + STRIDE) on codebase and generate a Red Team findings report

red-team-rebuttal.description: Analyze Red Team findings, fix vulnerabilities, and write a defense report

ux-design.description: Create UX/UI design deliverables (design tokens, components, layouts) using Stitch, Figma, existing UI audit, reference-driven design (DESIGN.md), direct frontend building, or Claude Design (Anthropic Labs)

ux-review.description: Review UX/UI deliverables against 22+ attack vectors (core 22 + optional design-system audit, slop-detect, click-path audit)

ux-rebuttal.description: Analyze UX review findings, fix UX deliverables, and write rebuttal report

ux-fix.description: Lightweight UX fix — apply review feedback directly, with optional design-system regen and demo recording

amend.description: Amend existing deliverables — add, change, or remove content with cross-document consistency

argument.hint: <phase> "<description>" e.g. ba "เพิ่ม forgot password flow"

backtrack.description: Analyze impact and execute a phase backtrack when downstream discovers upstream problems

next.description: Auto-detect current development phase and recommend next action

deliver.description: Generate final delivery handoff — readiness assessment, documentation finalization, and delivery summary
